title: Get the fields of an Instant Form
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the fields of an Instant Form (or lead form). To retrieve the Instant Form fields, you can also choose to create a mock lead using [/page/lead/mock/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739047132614722) and then extract the field names. However, we recommend you use this endpoint to get Instant Form fields directly. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pages/fields/get/|/v1.3/page/field/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`page_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`page_id`:string| |Response parameter data type|`page_id`: number
`create_time`: number|`page_id`: string
`create_time`: datetime| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/field/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|The content type of the request.
Allowed value: "application/json". ``` **Parameters** ```xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |page_id {Required}|string| The ID of the Instant Form. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -L -X GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/field/get/?advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID&page_id=PAGE_ID' \ -H 'Access-Token: xxx' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|The response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|The returned data. | #|fields|string| The Instant Form fields. | #|meta_data|object| Metadata about the Instant Form. | ##|page_id|string| The Instant Form ID. | ##|create_time|datetime| The creation time of the Instant Form. | ##|page_name|string| Page title. | ##| page_url|string| Instant Form URL.| |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "data": { "fields": [], "meta_data": {} } } (/code); ```
